_about: Google Maps directions read on 2026-11-17 (UTC) through the public directions URL with travelmode=walking. Each record keeps the exact query, the page title, every route card that was shown, and the mode marker text the page printed. The page was rendered in a French browser locale; numbers are copied as printed (a comma is a decimal separator, so '0,6 mile' is 0.6 mile). Google Maps is not an official venue source; no venue publishes a walking time. These are measurements from a non-official map service, labelled as such everywhere they appear. Minutes are the first (recommended) route card; every shown route is kept in routes[].
walkingModeMarker: The walking pages print 'Tous les itinéraires sont principalement plats' or 'Principalement plat' (English: 'All routes are mostly flat' / 'Mostly flat'). The driving control page prints traffic wording instead and no 'mostly flat' line.
